steps: Parked existing StarterPack Tools (Spear, Dagger) into ServerStorage
generate_mesh a falchion (wide curved single-edged cleaver blade, clipped point, straight crossguard, wrapped grip, round pommel) at 4-stud height
Captured front+right to confirm slender blade silhouette, then save_mesh to durable asset 118076795160551
make_tool with the blade mesh as Handle, moved Tool into StarterPack

recipe.text: Falchion: a fresh curved single-edged cleaver-sword concept distinct from prior daggers/spears/scimitars. Cube-generated mesh saved durable, toolified with the hilt as Handle. Fast state machine (0.1/0.12/0.3s) with a server-authoritative hitbox (30 dmg, 6-stud reach, 0.3s cooldown). No animation clips bound (scoped build); swing state machine fires the hitbox on its active window.
